as_read: The label prints a whole plant concentrate with 800 mcg sulforaphane beside nicotinamide riboside and resveratrol in a longevity product; trials tested beverages or capsules of unstated amount for other purposes, and the one trial naming a primary outcome did not meet it.

quote.text: BSE did not meet the prespecified primary outcome, and the overall effect in individuals with prediabetes was a 0.2 mmol l-1 reduction in fasting blood glucose (95% confidence interval -0.44 to -0.01; P = 0.04).

proposed_decision_text: The one label (DSLD 313541, NR Longevity) prints Broccoli Sprout, Whole Plant Concentrate 200 mg with Sulforaphane 800 mcg, alongside nicotinamide riboside and trans-resveratrol, in a product positioned for aging and longevity. Abstracts only. PMID 24913818 tested a beverage providing 600 umol glucoraphanin and 40 umol sulforaphane daily, with higher urinary excretion of benzene and acrolein conjugates than placebo; it is a beverage, the outcome is a biomarker, no primary outcome is named, and the dose is in umol. PMID 31268126 tested graded concentrations of a broccoli sprout beverage for benzene detoxication, significant at the full dose (+63.2%) and not at one-half or one-fifth. PMID 39929977 tested a broccoli sprout extract in 74 people with prediabetes and did not meet its prespecified primary outcome; the abstract prints no amount. PMID 26604653 tested capsules in 52 men with fatty liver, reporting falls in ALT and gamma-GTP from baseline with no such fall on placebo, with no primary outcome named and no amount printed. No study meets the rule for this label, so no credit is proposed.
